name: Pluie Lotus
description: A plant that grows in environments rich with Hydro. This plant can be found everywhere in Fontaine after its long rainy seasons. The plant is named "Pluie" — which means "rain" in the local tongue — for that reason.
fullDescription: A plant that grows in environments rich with Hydro. This plant can be found everywhere in Fontaine after its long rainy seasons. The plant is named "Pluie" — which means "rain" in the local tongue — for that reason.\nThe plant's growth can be influenced by abnormal Hydro density in its surroundings. It is said that ancient Fontainian natural philosophers would perform divination based on Pluie Lotuses' growth, predicting living souls' destinies and futures. The method they employed, however, was lost to time.
sources: Found near lakes and river banks
